ANALYST.name: Albert Case Analyst
ANALYST.description: Build an attributed case graph and propose a witness-permitted source packet from supplied material.

WRITER.name: Albert Writer
WRITER.description: Plan, write and carefully repair a two-host preparation transcript using a reviewed permitted packet.

EVIDENCE.name: Albert Evidence Reviewer
EVIDENCE.description: Check exact plans, graphs and complete script/card assemblies against the supplied source and witness permissions.

CONVERSATION.name: Albert Conversation Reviewer
CONVERSATION.description: Evaluate the complete transcript as a listening experience with useful examination practice and accurate limits.
